external_collaboration.evidence_quote: With Bluesea Systems and Pacer Marine Group, we have combined to bring to the local maritime market quality electrical and wiring solutions aimed primarily at the yachting industry, but have found favour also with recreational and emergency vehicles sectors.

With Bluesea Systems and Pacer Marine Group, we have combined to bring to the local maritime market quality electrical and wiring solutions aimed primarily at the yachting industry, but have found favour also with recreational and emergency vehicles sectors.
For over 30 years, we have been selling the Antex range of soldering irons and stations, and we stock a considerable amount of replacement bits for almost all the soldering irons we sell.
We also import and stock a wide selection of Uni-T test and measuring equipment.
Over the last couple of years, we have introduced and extended the modular electronics range, making Fabian Enterprises Ltd one of the biggest suppliers of Arduino main boards, shields and sensors.

We have extended the range of marine electrical products and we can supply a vast range of electrical components from the Blue Sea systems portfolio (circuit breakers, battery isolators, bus bars), Pacer marine-grade cable (single and multicore), Dolphin battery chargers, Power Master inverters, Scout marine antennas, Durite automotive electrical component, Antex soldering tools, Proskit hand tools and Marine VHF communications equipment from Standard Horizon.
